<title level="1" pfs="">[Stonefish Swarm](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3275)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Stonefish occasionally band together where food is abundant, filling all nooks and crannies of a coral reef. In large numbers, stonefish can take on prey much larger than themselves.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 16

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 11
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 2">[Stonefish Swarm](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3275)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Large" />
<trait label="Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=531" />
<trait label="Aquatic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=533" />
<trait label="Swarm" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=707" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 148

**Perception** +11; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69)

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +9, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +6, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +11

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +2

**Dex** +3

**Con** +2

**Int** -5

**Wis** +1

**Cha** -1
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 16 

**Fort** +11 

**Ref** +8 

**Will** +5 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 25

</row>

**Immunities**
precision, [swarm mind](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=78)

**Resistances**
bludgeoning 3, slashing 3

**Weaknesses**
area damage 3, [splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=699) damage 3

**Defensive Spines** When a creature enters the stonefish swarm's space, that creature takes 1d4 piercing damage and is exposed to stonefish swarm venom.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** swim 25 feet

**Inject Poison** <actions string="Single Action" />  Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 2d4 piercing damage (DC 18 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). Creatures that fail the save are exposed to stonefish swarm venom.

**Reef Camouflage** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) Until the next time it acts, the stonefish swarm appears to be a colorful coral reef. It has an automatic result of 26 on [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) checks and DCs to pass as a reef.

**Stonefish Swarm Venom**  ([Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126)) **Saving Throw** DC 18 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d6 poison and [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) (1 round); **Stage 2** 1d6 poison and clumsy 2 (1 round); **Stage 3** 2d6 poison damage and clumsy 2 (1 round)

</column>

<document level="2" id="creature-family-493" />
name: Stonefish Swarm
